picks.file: Vista de Coímbra desde la Universidad, Portugal, 2012-05-10, DD 03.JPG
picks.why: sharp color view over the city

gaps: P0: no candidates; P2: only a tiny copy plate on a book page (#5); P5: only a faded, distant 1967 slide (#8)
notes: #1 is the vol. 5 (1598) plate; Rijksmuseum dates it 1596. It has a faint center fold, not a gutter. #2 is a brighter colored copy but small and watermarked; #4 is the same plate uncolored (1640 edition); #3 is a book spread. #7 is low resolution (1463 px), a halftone from a 1913 book, so the photo may be a few years older. The P6 views (#10–#12) all look from the university over residential hills; none shows the university hill itself. #8 (1967) could fill P5 with trim [0, 0.45, 1, 1] and focal [0.55, 0.4] if a weak view is acceptable.
